description: One command installs 670+ security tools on Debian/Ubuntu/Kali, Fedora, Arch, openSUSE and Termux. Its authorization-gated MCP server runs them in a disposable Kata Containers VM sandbox for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and other MCP clients. 872 agent skills for CTF, pentesting, bug bounty, DFIR and red/blue teams.
